description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一。
description.en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value of this parameter is generated by the client and must be unique across different requests.

description.zh: 条件访问策略条件内容配置
description.en: The condition configuration of the conditional access policy.
The action configuration of the conditional access policy.

description.zh: 条件访问策略执行类型
description.en: The execution type of the conditional access policy.
The priority of the conditional access policy.
